# Fixprom — AI Prompt Studio untuk Konten TikTok, Reels & YouTube Shorts

> Fixprom (https://www.fixprom.com) is a production-grade AI prompt studio and short-form content ideation platform designed for digital creators, video editors, and AI filmmakers. It bridges creative ideation with model-specific prompt engineering for cutting-edge generative video models.

## Core Capabilities
- **Creative Diversity Engine**: Generates non-repetitive, culturally grounded content ideas across 21 specialized short-form categories (including POV Immersion, Restoration ASMR, Microdrama, Local Folklore, and Educational Paradox).
- **Model-Specific Prompt Compiler**: Dynamically formats cinematic prompts to match the exact syntax, keyword priorities, and negative constraints of leading AI video generators (Google Veo 2, Kling 1.5/2.0 Pro, MiniMax Hailuo Video-01, OpenAI Sora, Runway Gen-3 Alpha Turbo, and Luma Ray 2).
- **Automated Quality Control (QC) Continuity**: Analyzes multi-scene storyboards to enforce visual character continuity anchors (outfit, hair, color palette) and aspect ratio synchronization.
- **Trend Radar**: Aggregates verified viral video patterns from TikTok Creative Center, YouTube Culture & Trends, and Meta Creators with concrete hook breakdowns.
- **Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) Video Connect**: Zero-plaintext security architecture utilizing client-side AES-256-GCM encryption for users to generate videos directly via their own API keys (MiniMax Hailuo, Kling, Runway, Luma).
